messages:
alex: Heads-up — master is red on integration CI since last night. kv-cache-integration keeps failing on the macOS runners. Can someone bisect? :eyes:

ci-bot: [CI] Build #4821 failed — kv-cache-integration (mac-min-3) — https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/4821

alex: Failure log excerpt:
```
FAILED tests/test_kv_cache_integration.py::test_kv_eviction_on_merge
AssertionError: Expected cache size 1024 but got 768
Stack: src/runtime/kv_cache.cc:412
```

sam: I can take a quick look. Any idea when this started being flaky? Last green commit SHA?

alex: Last known green on master was around commit 5f3a1d8 (yesterday afternoon). First red observed in the overnight run at ~02:30.

nina: If it's reproducible locally on mac, we can bisect. I suspect a change in the compaction code (mike landed a refactor yesterday). @mike did you touch kv_cache.cc?

mike: yes — I refactored the compaction heuristics and added a new path for partial-compact. I ran unit tests but not the integration wrap. Could be mine.

sam: OK let's bisect. Alex — can you post a branch/clone url and minimal repro script? I can run git bisect on mac runner pool.

alex: repro is flaky locally for me but reproduces with tests/test_kv_cache_integration.py::test_kv_eviction_on_merge plus env TEST_RETRIES=3. Clone: git@github.com:redwood-inference/serving.git

alex: minimal bisect commands (run on CI runner with the mac image):
```
# from repo root
git checkout master
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
# mark current HEAD as bad
git bisect bad
# mark last known green
git checkout 5f3a1d8 && git bisect good
# run test, then git bisect good/bad accordingly
```

nina: I'll queue a runner and start the bisect now. Will post updates as it progresses.

ci-bot: [CI] Runner macos-3 allocated (runner-452) by nina.

nina: First bisect step: candidate commit 7a9b2c4 (mike/refactor-compact). Running test...

nina: test failed on commit 7a9b2c4 — marking bad. Continuing.

sam: Nice — sounds like it lands on mike's change. If bisect narrows to a single commit we should coordinate a revert and a quick patch. Also add an integration test that reproduces the regression deterministically if possible.

mike: If it's my commit I'm happy to open a revert and follow up with a fix. Can you post the full failing test log when bisect finds the culprit?

nina: Bisect result: first bad commit 7a9b2c4 (author: Mike Lee).

nina: Full failing trace (attached):
```
[...full log omitted...]
AssertionError: Expected cache size 1024 but got 768
Backtrace:
  kv_cache.cc:412
  compaction.cc:87
  merge.cc:240
```

alex: Thanks — mike, can you do a quick revert PR so we can get master green? Revert should be small: revert 7a9b2c4.

mike: Opening revert PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1892 Reverts commit 7a9b2c4.

ci-bot: [PR] PR #1892 opened by mike — revert(refactor-compact): revert partial compact refactor — https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1892

sam: I'll trigger an internal smoke build after merge. If green, we can re-land with tests.

alex: Thanks all. Follow-up actions: 1) get revert merged ASAP 2) re-run full integration matrix 3) mike to add a deterministic integration test for eviction 4) postmortem note in #postmortems if revert affects customers.

mike: Will add tests and a more thorough test matrix before re-landing. Sorry about the disruption. :pray:

nina: Revert merged, CI now queued.

ci-bot: [CI] Build #4826 started (post-revert smoke).

ci-bot: [CI] Build #4826 succeeded — all integration tests green. :white_check_mark:

alex: Master is green again. Thanks for the fast triage and bisect run everyone.

sam: Great job — I'll follow up with a small blamemap/notes on what made the integration nondeterministic.

mike: will start the rework with added tests in a feature branch.

alex: Closing this thread. If anything else shows up ping here or open an incident. :rocket:
